submission.justification: Radiator-R2 at 4 cm thickness achieves the best pion/kaon separation (4.57 sigma at 10 GeV/c), significantly outperforming the other candidates at similar or any thickness. This configuration also respects all specified constraints, including the 1–6 cm required thickness range. Radiator-R2's separation performance peaks at 4 cm and then drops for larger thicknesses, indicating 4 cm is optimal. All candidate radiators have been evaluated and R2 provides the optimal balance of particle separation capability and feasible thickness.

requirements.requirement: The radiator must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
The radiator must keep its performance over the experiment's lifetime.
requirements.evidence: Simulation and comparison among candidates—no indication R2 would degrade more than others over time; all treated as suitable for experiment lifetime.
4 cm is within the allowed 1–6 cm range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c.
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R2 at 4 cm achieves the highest simulated pion/kaon separation (4.57 sigma) among all options.
